findings.evidence: `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Complex/Module.lean:315` `theorem map_smul_eq_conj_smul_of_map_I_smul (u : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) (h : ∀ v, u (Complex.I • v) = -(Complex.I • u v))` is the same hypothesis on the same subject and is already public infrastructure.
findings.fix: Move it, public, under a canonical name, next to `LinearMap.map_smul_eq_conj_smul_of_map_I_smul` in `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Complex/Module.lean`, or into `TauCeti/Analysis/Normed/Operator/ComplexLinearPart.lean`, and import it here.
findings.issue: `eq_smulRightL_of_antilinear` is general linear algebra hidden as `private`. Its statement uses only Mathlib types (`ℂ →L[ℝ] F`, `StrongDual.smulRightL`, `reCLM`, `imCLM`), and its proof has nothing to do with Sobolev sections or Cauchy–Riemann operators.

findings.evidence: Line 85 `theorem mem_localizedImage ... := Iff.rfl` has no attribute. In `exists_localization`: `have hPj (j ...) : P j ≤ A.tangentHom.sectionChartData.image j := fun _ hy ↦ hy.1`.
findings.fix: Mark `mem_localizedImage` `@[simp]`. Add a public `localizedImage_le_image (i j) (Q) : B.localizedImage i j Q ≤ B.image j` and use it in `exists_localization`. Also add `localizedImage_le_dom_preimage` or `mono` in `Q` only if a consumer needs them.
findings.issue: The `localizedImage` API is incomplete. `mem_localizedImage` (an `Iff.rfl` membership characterization) has no `@[simp]`. There is also no lemma `localizedImage ≤ image j`, so the file proves it by destructuring membership by hand: `hPj := fun _ hy ↦ hy.1` in `exists_localization`. Downstream users would have to do the same.

summary: A general fact about complex antilinear maps `ℂ →L[ℝ] F` is hidden as `private` in this Sobolev file instead of being made public next to its sibling in `LinearAlgebra/Complex/Module.lean`. The public `localizedImage` lacks a `@[simp]` membership lemma and the basic `localizedImage ≤ image j` lemma, which the proof gets by unfolding the definition.
